I answered Hollis in a thread on their message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

I found it in #central-team, a channel Hollis is in. On 9 Jun, Priyanka said Pine Crossing's morning receiver could only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, so a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note instead of being booked.

I couldn't find a street address or site ID for Pine Crossing in the channels or files Hollis can see, and I said so in the reply. I suggested asking store ops or checking the rollout tracker.
